name: Clone Alpha
summary: Clone Alpha is a musculoskeletal android from Clone Robotics that moves with water-powered Myofiber artificial muscles instead of electric motors. The Protoclone V1 prototype was shown hanging in a workshop video in February 2025. Clone takes reservations for 279 Alpha Edition units but has published no price or delivery date.
hands: Clone Hand with Myofiber muscles; Clone claims human-level finger strength.
compute: GPU edge computing (no model named on the official page).
highlights: Myofiber muscle: under 50 ms response, 30%+ contraction, 1 kg+ force per 3 g fiber (company figures).
Company reports $17 million raised and a roadmap toward commercial products in 2028.
caveats: Shown only suspended from a frame; no public walking demo.
No price, height or weight published.
Specs come from press coverage of a prototype video.

sources.title: The Synthetic Human Roadmap: Clone Robotics Eyes Silicon Valley and $20,000 Price Points
